attempts.sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
JOIN code.symbols base ON cb.base_symbol_id = base.symbol_id
JOIN code.calls c ON c.caller_symbol_id = base.symbol_id AND c.callee_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
WHERE s.qualname LIKE 'Group.%'
  AND s.file_id = 'src/click/core.py'
  AND base.qualname = 'Command'
  AND base.file_id = 'src/click/core.py'
  AND c.resolution = 'same_file'
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

request:
Which methods of the Group class in src/click/core.py override a method that its base class Command (same file) defines itself under the same name? Count only methods written in the body of Command, not ones Command inherits; __init__ counts as an override. Give the symbol ID of the Group method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: The query finds Group methods in src/click/core.py that have a same_file call from the Command base class, meaning they override a Command method defined in the same file. It joins symbols to class_bases to locate Command as a base of Group, then checks for direct call edges from Command to each Group method with same_file resolution, counting only those with at least one such call.
sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
JOIN code.symbols base ON cb.base_symbol_id = base.symbol_id
JOIN code.calls c ON c.caller_symbol_id = base.symbol_id AND c.callee_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
WHERE s.qualname LIKE 'Group.%'
  AND s.file_id = 'src/click/core.py'
  AND base.qualname = 'Command'
  AND base.file_id = 'src/click/core.py'
  AND c.resolution = 'same_file'
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
